items.title: Wendy Oxenhorn interviewed by Monk Rowe, via Zoom, January 22, 2026
items.q: Oh, my boyfriend – I love him. I think he’s almost a hundred and still playing.

ctx.x: sort of “had it made.” Like all they had to do was play jazz gigs and they made a lot of money. And one time I had interviewed Gene Bertoncini, and he happened to mention –
Oh, my boyfriend – I love him. I think he’s almost a hundred and still playing.
The next day he was playing a wedding. And I said, “You’re playing a wedding?” Like I mean I know this stuff because I’m a musician too.
